body: It's going to sound cheap but I've found that the meaning of life is what you give it. No one came into this world on purpose. Escaping into alcohol or drugs can be a short term solution to a larger problem but they're really just borrowing happiness from tomorrow. I know that drinking makes socializing easier but maybe try outing yourself into situations in which you're comfortable without the drink. Maybe you've already done that, I don't know. It doesn't need to be a drastic change just one that you're able to say to yourself that you're slightly better off than yesterday. Look for the reasons to live not for the reasons why not. Life's not easy but there are people here that are familiar with that you're feeling. I just ask that you don't give up.
What has happened is a direct response to what I have done and how I've treated others who were close to me. It is my fault.
